# Story 16.2: Align the settings schema and handler field names for tax_free_income

Status: in-progress

## Story

As a developer,
I want the settings body schema and handler to agree on the `tax_free_income` field name (with required validation per AD-11),
So that the value is no longer silently dropped on write and round-trips correctly (P0 item #3 from Aspect 9 of the critical review).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Story 16.1's red-phase tests pass: a settings write including `tax_free_income` persists it, and a subsequent read returns the same value.
2. The body schema at `apps/server/src/app/routes/settings/index.ts:168` and the handler destructure at line ~192 agree on the `tax_free_income` field name — no more snake_case/camelCase mismatch that drops the value to undefined.
3. No other settings field behavior changes: all other fields still validate, persist, and round-trip exactly as before.
4. The previously-skipped tests from Story 16.1 are unskipped (`.skip()` removed) and pass under `nx test server`; the full server suite is green with no pre-existing test modified, weakened, or removed.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [x] Task 1 (AC: #1–#3): Remove skip markers and confirm red.
  - [x] 1.1 In the specs added by Story 16.1, remove every `it.skip` marker and run `nx test server`, confirming the new assertions FAIL against current code (red).
- [x] Task 2 (AC: #2): Align the schema/handler field names.
  - [x] 2.1 In `apps/server/src/app/routes/settings/index.ts`, make the body schema declaration (line ~168) and the handler destructure (line ~192) use the same field name for tax-free income, so a POST with that field is accepted and persisted rather than dropped to undefined.
  - [x] 2.2 Apply required validation per AD-11 if the field should be mandatory; otherwise keep it optional but consistently named on both sides.
- [ ] Task 3 (AC: #3): Verify no other field regressed.
  - [ ] 3.1 Confirm all other settings fields still validate, persist, and round-trip unchanged.
- [ ] Task 4 (AC: #4): Confirm green suite.
  - [ ] 4.1 Run `nx test server` and confirm fully green with Story 16.1's tests now passing (unskipped).

## Dev Notes

- **Why:** at `apps/server/src/app/routes/settings/index.ts:168,192` the body schema declares `tax_free_income` but the handler destructures `taxFreeIncome`, so the tax-free income group is always silently dropped (undefined) on every POST — a data-loss bug. This is P0 item #3 from Aspect 9.
- **First task is always unskip → confirm red → implement.** The red-phase tests from Story 16.1 define the target; do not edit their assertions to make them pass, only the production code.
- **Pick one canonical name:** decide whether the wire format is `tax_free_income` (snake_case) or `taxFreeIncome` (camelCase) and use it on BOTH the schema and the handler. Match whatever the client already sends so no client change is needed; if both exist, prefer the one the client uses.
- Vitest is the workspace test framework; server tests run via `nx test server`.

### Project Structure Notes

- Modify: `apps/server/src/app/routes/settings/index.ts` (align schema + handler field name for tax-free income).
- Modify: Story 16.1's spec (remove `.skip()` markers only — no assertion changes).
